shortDescription: Module to manage network interfaces of Virtual Machines in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the nic to manage.

options.name: interface
options.description: Type of the network interface. For example e1000, pci_passthrough, rtl8139, rtl8139_virtio, spapr_vlan or virtio. It's required parameter when creating the new NIC.

options.name: linked
options.description: Defines if the NIC is linked to the virtual machine.

options.name: mac_address
options.description: Custom MAC address of the network interface, by default it's obtained from MAC pool.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the network interface to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: network
options.description: Logical network to which the VM network interface should use, by default Empty network is used if network is not specified.

options.name: network_filter_parameters
options.description: The list of network filter parameters.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: profile
options.description: Virtual network interface profile to be attached to VM network interface. When not specified and network has only single profile it will be auto-selected, otherwise you must specify profile.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the Virtual Machine NIC be present/absent/plugged/unplugged.

options.name: template
options.description: Name of the template to manage. You must provide either C(vm) parameter or C(template) parameter.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: vm
options.description: Name of the Virtual Machine to manage. You must provide either C(vm) parameter or C(template) parameter.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
